name: The Remains of Trey Lightforge
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: You pick up the sack carefully and prepare to make your way back to Jessir Moonbow on the border of Felwood and Ashenvale. Hopefully the paladin will be given the proper respects once you've passed his remains on to his friends.
narrative.objectives: Return the Remains of Trey Lightforge to Jessir Moonbow in Felwood.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You've done it! Praise be to Elune and whichever powers you worshihp, adventurer. You have done an honorable and noble thing this day. I am certain Arko'narin will be pleased that you not only took the time to save her, but to also slay the creature who tortured one of her best friends.

I wish I could do more for you, but please, take this.
narrative.requestItemsText: How did things go in Jaedenar, adventurer?

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 55 to 57, 23,350 XP in all.

quests.name: A Strange Red Key
quests.objectiveText: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.

quests.name: Rescue From Jaedenar
quests.objectiveText: Escort Arko'narin to where Lightforge and her equipment are being held, and then protect her as you escape Shadow Hold.

quests.name: Retribution of the Light
quests.objectiveText: Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.

quests.name: The Remains of Trey Lightforge
quests.objectiveText: Return the Remains of Trey Lightforge to Jessir Moonbow in Felwood.
